# Schedule Exception

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ScheduleException`](gmeow-ScheduleException.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ScheduleException>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An exception to a recurring event schedule — a cancellation or rescheduling of a specific generated occurrence. A relator mediating the schedule, the original date, and optionally a replacement event. Retained with displayable false rather than deleted ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ScheduleException`](gmeow-ScheduleException.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when one occurrence of a recurring schedule is cancelled or moved — the RFC 5545 EXDATE/RECURRENCE-ID case — so the deviation is recorded against the rule without rewriting it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for changing the whole series (edit the [`gmeow:scheduleRecurrenceRule`](../properties/gmeow-scheduleRecurrenceRule.md) instead) and never delete the affected occurrence — a cancelled occurrence is displayable false plus this exception, retained ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### How to use

- Link it to its [`gmeow:exceptionSchedule`](../properties/gmeow-exceptionSchedule.md), stamp the [`gmeow:exceptionOriginalDate`](../properties/gmeow-exceptionOriginalDate.md) of the occurrence it overrides, set [`gmeow:exceptionType`](../properties/gmeow-exceptionType.md), and add [`gmeow:exceptionReplacementEvent`](../properties/gmeow-exceptionReplacementEvent.md) for a reschedule (omit it for a pure cancellation).

### Examples

- ex:standupSkip a [`gmeow:ScheduleException`](gmeow-ScheduleException.md); [`gmeow:exceptionSchedule`](../properties/gmeow-exceptionSchedule.md) ex:standupSchedule; [`gmeow:exceptionOriginalDate`](../properties/gmeow-exceptionOriginalDate.md) "2026-06-19T09:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); [`gmeow:exceptionType`](../properties/gmeow-exceptionType.md) [`gmeow:exceptionTypeCancellation`](../individuals/gmeow-exceptionTypeCancellation.md).
